result.title: Recover or expire a retained private Home
result.acceptance:
**Expected behaviour** · Provide an authorized local recovery procedure within 30 days of confirmed closure. Define identity verification, restoration to the original identity, fresh credentials and a bounded purge of the correct retained Home and associated retained data.

**Verify** · Use disposable stores and a controlled clock. Test just before the 30-day deadline, at it and after it, a reused username, restart during restore or purge, and an unrelated Home. Document what a separate operator backup retains.

**Delivery dependencies** · WI-055, WI-071

**Queue** · Follows WI-071 in the v0.3 delivery order.

**Target** · PI-03, v0.3.
result.evidence: account-extra.test.mjs closes a member at 2026-01-01, restarts at 2026-02-01 and asserts the retained Home and account row are gone and the username can join with a new identity.
